'''Emergency Code Zero''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] emergency code. If a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] were to receive this signal, it was to immediately divert from its current task and assist.

The code was activated at the [[Space Battle at Kuat]], when ships of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] attacked a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The activation of the code resulted in the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyranny]]'' being diverted from its post at [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]], where it had been stationed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself.
